insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,759,421 to $7,759,421, a 1x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 23 (-36 over 90 days) and market heat at 13 (-12).
